name: run_id
description: Identifier of the pipeline run

name: timestamp
description: UTC time the row was written

name: path
description: Module path relative to the input root

name: success
description: Validation passed and every generated test passed

name: routed_tier
description: Tier chosen by the routing policy: frontier or open

name: final_tier
description: Tier that produced the final output

name: escalated
description: True when the module was escalated to a stronger tier after a failure

name: difficulty
description: Difficulty score in 0..1 from the router

name: routing_policy
description: always_frontier, always_open or complexity

name: routing_model
description: Model chosen by the router

name: final_model
description: Model of the last attempt

name: n_attempts
description: Number of convert and repair attempts

name: input_tokens
description: Input tokens summed over all models

name: output_tokens
description: Output tokens summed over all models

name: cost_usd
description: Estimated model cost for the module

name: duration_s
description: Wall-clock seconds spent on the module

name: tests_total
description: Generated tests collected; null when no tests were run

name: tests_passed
description: Generated tests that passed

name: tests_failed
description: Generated tests that failed

name: tests_errors
description: Generated tests that errored

name: tests_timed_out
description: True when the test run hit its timeout

name: validation_issue_codes
description: Validation issue codes from the last attempt

name: error
description: Pipeline error message, if any

name: converted_source
description: Converted code; only populated when the sink runs with include_source
